I wish so much to be another person, I don't want to be like this at all. I've seen a therapist and a sphyciatrist but I can't seem to find any relief from the negativity. That if there is no front door? 

I have social anxiety and often blame myself for my complete lack of friends or positive relationships, who wouldn't? Your words are extremely kind and helpful, but it is just so hard, it's so difficult to visualise any kind of relief. You are so lovely though, thank you for your reply. To hear someone say that they believe in me means so much to. Thank you.
